latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of article-rewriter skill.

- Restructures and rewrites various content types (articles, newsletters, scripts, landing pages, notes) to be clearer, more engaging, and persuasive.
- Uses APAG (Attention, Perspective, Advantage, Gamify) as the default framework for rewrites, optimizing for curiosity and action.
- Maintains the original author’s core facts and intent; avoids fabricating facts or testimonials.
- Defaults to 3 headline/hook options plus the rewritten article as output.
- Adapts output length, tone, structure, and target format to user needs; supports both minor polishing and full rewrites.
- Designed to flexibly support both Chinese and English content audiences.
